decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the above, the development hereby permitted shall be coloured black or grey only, unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the development.

Condition : 4 - The keypad to operate the traffic barrier hereby permitted shall be mounted on its post (being the 900mm high post shown on approved Drawing No. 1 - as annotated by the Council), unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of the development.
Condition : 5 - The arm of the traffic barrier shall only swing inwards towards Manor House Court when operated.
description: Installation of traffic barrier to entrance road between 1 Manor House Way and 17-21 Church Street
